1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.
Heard the counsel for petitioners.

2. The challenge is to Public Notice dated 31st July 2025 issued under Section 21 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 ('Act of 2013'), in respect of the land described in prayer clause.

8. Issue notice to the remaining respondent, returnable on 22nd September 2025.

9. We make it clear that no further action pursuant to the notice under Section 21 of the Act of 2013,
as against the land of the petitioners, be undertaken till returnable date.

10. The aforesaid injunction order is passed taking in view the prima facie satisfaction of this Court and the schedule as ordered by the Apex Court appears to be mandatory in nature.
11. List on 22nd September 2025 along with W.P.(C) 11820/2025 titled as "Lokesh Lochav & Anr vs.
Govt. NCT of Delhi & Ors."
